articles.summary: For Andrea White, finding career success never came from a desire to climb the ‘corporate ladder,’ rather, a need to solve challenges and voice solutions. ‘Fixing problems’ is where she found the most fulfillment, a mindset that led her up a winding path to becoming Sonoco’s Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) in March 2025, only the second woman to hold that position in the Company’s 125+ year history.
articles.title: Engineer to Executive: Andrea White’s Path to Becoming Sonoco CHRO

articles.summary: As foodservice industry trends continue to evolve, quick-service restaurants (QSRs) are under growing pressure to deliver speed, consistency, and quality without adding complexity to operations. Trends in foodservice today demand smarter, more efficient solutions behind the counter, as operators navigate labor challenges and rising customer expectations.
articles.title: Foodservice Trends Driving QSR Efficiency and Growth
